profile.headline: Software Developer at Infosys
profile.summary: Hello! My name is Quinesha James, I'm an outgoing determined individual. I am a current Alumna of Indiana University Purdue University of Indianapolis. I'm a proud member of Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority, Incorporated and work heavily to help improve our community through community service.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Coded internal training solutions using programming languages such as C#, SQL, and HTML5 
Learned new technologies to help design and improve applications
Unix/Linux Administration and Windows Administration - Creating servers, changing privileges, creating space etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Coded internal SQL solutions and trained with multiple types of technology frequently
Helped improve applications designed around cognitive solutions and demonstrated for company
Created and perform solutions, gathered metadata and extracted into various types of software

positions.title: Object-Oriented Programming Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Debug C# Programming code while assisting frequent design and debug questions. Coded user friendly applications and overviewed student projects.

company.name: Indiana University Purdue University of Indianapolis

positions.title: Sociology Staff Assistant
positions.description: Coordinate and host up to 6 department events additionally provided training to incoming staff. Assisted frequent questions for graduate and undergraduate students. Also, updated database information.

positions.title: Problem Solve
positions.description: Addressed and resolved conflicts for customers while calibrating with different departments to ensure customer satisfaction.
